source_caption:
🎬 Old School (2003)

Old School follows three longtime friends, Mitch, Frank, and Beanie, who find themselves struggling with the responsibilities and frustrations of adulthood. After Mitch discovers his girlfriend has been cheating on him, he moves into a house near a college campus, where his friends convince him to start an unofficial fraternity. What begins as a simple attempt to relive their younger days quickly turns into a series of outrageous parties, hilarious misunderstandings, and wild adventures. As their fraternity attracts attention from students and university officials, the friends must fight to keep their new lifestyle alive. Combining unforgettable comedy, ridiculous situations, and chaotic friendships, the film explores growing older, nostalgia, friendship, and the hilarious consequences of refusing to grow up.

🎭 Genre: Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 7.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 28m • R

🎥 Director: Todd Phillips

🏆 Recognition: Starring Luke Wilson, Will Ferrell, and Vince Vaughn, the film became a popular comedy classic, especially remembered for Will Ferrell’s hilarious performance and its memorable fraternity scenes.

source_details.synopsis: Old School is a 2003 American comedy film directed and co-written by Todd Phillips. The film stars Luke Wilson, Will Ferrell, and Vince Vaughn as depressed men in their thirties who seek to relive their college days by starting a fraternity, and the tribulations they encounter in doing so. Old School was produced by The Montecito Picture Company and released by DreamWorks Pictures on February 21, 2003. The film received mixed reviews from critics, and grossed $87.1 million worldwide on a $24 million budget.
